question: In which of the following dances from Assam do the movements by the dancers resemble butterflies and birds?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bagurumba**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The** Bagurumba** is a **traditional dance of the Boro people** living in the State of Assam and North East India.
 
• In this dance, movements by the dancers resemble butterflies and birds.
 
• The **Bodo women perform** the Bagurumba dance, wearing their colourful traditional attire **dokhna, jwmgra **and** aronai**.
 
• Musical instruments used for Bagurumba Dance:
 
 
• Sifung
 
• Serja
 
• kham
 
• Jota
 
• Gongwna​​ 
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• In addition to **Bagurumba, Bardwisikhla dance, Mwsaglangnai dance, Dahal-tungri sibnai dance, Sikri sikla dance, Daosri delai dance, Sa-gwlao mwsanai, Kopri sibnai mwsanai ** are several other important dances.
 
• Some other **dance forms of assam** are - 
 
 
• **Bihu**
 
• **Sattriya**
 
• **Ojhapali and Deodhani Nritya**
 
• **Jhumar Dance**
 
• **Pai Majai**
 
 

7c
